changed_evidentiary_state: Target-chemistry manufacturability is now testable with a preregistered >=1 cm^2 stabilized-useful-work scale-transfer gate instead of being inferred from cross-material scale precedents.

scope.chemistry: D18:eC9 baseline and blinded D18:PY-IT:eC9 arms
scope.note: 0.041 cm^2 is literature-derived from the target anchor Methods; 1.0 cm^2 is the existing repository scale-transfer stage, not a newly inferred optimum.

fail_closed_rules: Missing >=3 independent fabrication lots => INCOMPLETE for project useful-work promotion.
Unknown B0 field-generation, collection, or yield margin => INCOMPLETE rather than PASS.
An arm that improves small-area performance but fails the existing >=5% stabilized-Pmax large-area gate is not a scale-transfer useful-work PASS.
A favorable large-area result with changed HTL/electrode lots or uncontrolled D18 lot is not attributable to active-layer EPC/interface physics.

synthetic_fixture.note: Values are arbitrary arithmetic fixtures and are not device predictions or material constants.

falsifier: A blinded >=1 cm^2 candidate arm that does not retain >=5% relative stabilized-Pmax improvement across >=3 independent fabrication lots, or that loses field-generation/collection robustness, fails scale-transfer useful-work promotion even if small-area voltage-loss metrics improve.
